internal_measurement.results: Release-mode USI binary was rebuilt from commit be30e7d. Workspace tests, lint, formatting, the stdlib A/B-runner early-stop test, documentation-reference, public-surface, release-manifest, and cargo-publish-workflow checks passed. The USI smoke transcript reached usiok and readyok. S16 accepted H1 at 524 wins, 410 losses, and 23 draws (LLR +3.00; bounds +/-2.94) for dev/next versus v0.3.50 under a pre-fixed local protocol: one thread, SpecTopN=0, external HalfKP, 0.5 seconds per move, balanced openings, H0=0 Elo, H1=+10 Elo, alpha=beta=0.05. S17 first crossed H1 at 462 wins, 354 losses, and 48 draws (LLR +2.96), but ten in-flight games drained during shutdown moved the final aggregate below the boundary (LLR +2.83); S17 alone is inconclusive. Recorded 100k-node probes on 40 midgame and 10 opening positions preserved best move, score, depth, and node count on x86 and arm. These scoped diagnostics are not general playing-strength claims.

external_opponents.configuration: No external-engine result is a release criterion or an external-engine superiority claim.

known_limitations: The S16 result applies only to its fixed external HalfKP file, balanced-opening corpus, one-thread configuration, SpecTopN=0, and 0.5-second budget; it does not establish general strength or external-engine superiority.

S17 crossed the early-stop boundary before shutdown but its finalized aggregate fell below it after in-flight games completed; a future gate needs a predeclared drain policy before S17 can be treated as decisive.
No NNUE checkpoint is bundled or adopted; the optional v0.3.38 checkpoint and its material-baseline recommendation remain unchanged.
External HalfKP 256x2-32-32 inference remains optional and requires a separately obtained, license-compatible nn.bin file with its own provenance and operating scale.
